scripts.title: VINQ INTERFACE TEMPLATE UI
scripts.script:
local ImageUrl = "https://scriptblox.com/images/photo/6a4435d460023d64d5b1ba1c-1782855167902.jpeg"
local LogoAsset = ""

if writefile and getcustomasset and game.HttpGet then
	local success, _ = pcall(function()
		if isfile and not isfile("vinq_interface_logo.png") then
			writefile("vinq_interface_logo.png", game:HttpGet(ImageUrl))
		end
		if isfile and isfile("vinq_interface_logo.png") then
			LogoAsset = getcustomasset("vinq_interface_logo.png")
		end
	end)
	if not success or LogoAsset == "" then
		LogoAsset = "rbxassetid://6031075931"
	end
else
	LogoAsset = "rbxassetid://6031075931"
end

local Logos = {
	Home     = "rbxassetid://6031094667",
	Combat   = "rbxassetid://6023426915",
	Visuals  = "rbxassetid://6023426926",
	Player   = "rbxassetid://6031075931",
	Settings = "rbxassetid://6031260482"
}

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local Theme = {
	Main = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 26),
	Sidebar = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20),
	Header = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 16),
	Accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 0),
	AccentDark = Color3.fromRGB(180, 130, 0),
	ItemBg = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 36),
	ItemHover = Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 48),
	Text = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240),
	SubText = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 170)
}

if game.CoreGui:FindFirstChild("VinqsHubUI") then
	game.CoreGui.VinqsHubUI:Destroy()
end

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "VinqsHubUI"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local success, _ = pcall(function()
	ScreenGui.Parent = game.CoreGui
end)
if not success then
	ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local NotifContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
NotifContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 1, 0)
NotifContainer.Position = UDim2.new(1, -270, 0, 10)
NotifContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
NotifContainer.ZIndex = 999
NotifContainer.Parent = ScreenGui

local NotifLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
NotifLayout.Parent = NotifContainer
NotifLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
NotifLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
NotifLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)

local function Notify(title, message, duration)
	duration = duration or 3
	
	local box = Instance.new("Frame")
	box.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 60)
	box.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Main
	box.Position = UDim2.new(1, 300, 0, 0)
	box.Parent = NotifContainer
	
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	corner.Parent = box
	
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Theme.Accent
	stroke.Thickness = 1.5
	stroke.Parent = box
	
	local tLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	tLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 20)
	tLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 6)
	tLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	tLabel.Text = title
	tLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Accent
	tLabel.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	tLabel.TextSize = 13
	tLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	tLabel.Parent = box
	
	local mLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	mLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 28)
	mLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 26)
	mLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	mLabel.Text = message
	mLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.SubText
	mLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	mLabel.TextSize = 11
	mLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	mLabel.TextWrapped = true
	mLabel.Parent = box
	
	TweenService:Create(box, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	}):Play()
	
	task.delay(duration, function()
		local slideOut = TweenService:Create(box, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
			Position = UDim2.new(1, 300, 0, 0)
		})
		slideOut:Play()
		slideOut.Completed:Connect(function()
			box:Destroy()
		end)
	end)
end

TopBarCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)

local HeaderLogo = Instance.new("ImageLabel")

HeaderLogoCorner.Parent = HeaderLogo

HeaderTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
HeaderTitle.Text = "VINQ HUB"
HeaderTitle.TextColor3 = Theme.Accent
HeaderTitle.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
HeaderTitle.TextSize = 14
HeaderTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
HeaderTitle.Parent = TopBar

local dragging, dragStart, startPos
TopBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = MainFrame.Position
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = false
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
		}):Play()
	end
end)

MinimizeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30)
MinimizeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0.5, -15)
MinimizeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.ItemBg
MinimizeBtn.Text = "-"
MinimizeBtn.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
MinimizeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
MinimizeBtn.TextSize = 16

MinimizeBtn.Parent = TopBar

local mCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

local CloseBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
CloseBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30)
CloseBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0.5, -15)
CloseBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.ItemBg
CloseBtn.Text = "X"
CloseBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 70, 70)
CloseBtn.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
CloseBtn.TextSize = 13
CloseBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
CloseBtn.Parent = TopBar

local cCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
cCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
cCorner.Parent = CloseBtn

CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	}):Play()
	task.wait(0.2)
	ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)

local isMinimized = false
MinimizeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	isMinimized = not isMinimized
	if isMinimized then
		TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 560, 0, 42)
		}):Play()
		MinimizeBtn.Text = "+"
	else
		TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 560, 0, 380)
		}):Play()
		MinimizeBtn.Text = "-"
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if not gpe and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then
		MainFrame.Visible = not MainFrame.Visible
	end
end)

local Sidebar = Instance.new("Frame")
Sidebar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 1, -42)
Sidebar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 42)
Sidebar.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Sidebar
Sidebar.BorderSizePixel = 0
Sidebar.Parent = MainFrame

local SidebarLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
SidebarLayout.Parent = Sidebar
SidebarLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
SidebarLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)

SidebarPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)
SidebarPadding.Parent = Sidebar

local Container = Instance.new("Frame")
Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, -152, 1, -52)
Container.Position = UDim2.new(0, 146, 0, 46)
Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Container.Parent = MainFrame

local Tabs = {}
local FirstTab = true

local function CreateTab(tabName, logoAssetId)
	local tabBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	tabBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 34)
	tabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.ItemBg
	tabBtn.Text = ""
	tabBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
	tabBtn.Parent = Sidebar

	local tCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	tCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	tCorner.Parent = tabBtn

	local tabIcon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	tabIcon.Size = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 18)
	tabIcon.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -9)
	tabIcon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	tabIcon.Image = logoAssetId or Logos.Home
	tabIcon.ImageColor3 = Theme.SubText
	tabIcon.Parent = tabBtn

	local tabText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	tabText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 1, 0)
	tabText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 34, 0, 0)
	tabText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	tabText.Text = tabName
	tabText.TextColor3 = Theme.SubText
	tabText.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	tabText.TextSize = 12
	tabText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	tabText.Parent = tabBtn

	local page = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	page.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	page.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	page.Visible = false
	page.ScrollBarThickness = 3
	page.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Theme.Accent
	page.Parent = Container

	local pageLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	pageLayout.Parent = page
	pageLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	pageLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)

	local pagePadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	pagePadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6)
	pagePadding.Parent = page

	Tabs[tabName] = {Btn = tabBtn, Icon = tabIcon, Text = tabText, Page = page}

	tabBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		for _, data in pairs(Tabs) do
			data.Page.Visible = false
			TweenService:Create(data.Btn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.ItemBg}):Play()
			TweenService:Create(data.Icon, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {ImageColor3 = Theme.SubText}):Play()
			TweenService:Create(data.Text, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {TextColor3 = Theme.SubText}):Play()
		end
		
		page.Visible = true
		TweenService:Create(tabBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(tabIcon, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(tabText, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)}):Play()
	end)

	tabBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		if page.Visible == false then
			TweenService:Create(tabBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.ItemHover}):Play()
		end
	end)

	tabBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		if page.Visible == false then
			TweenService:Create(tabBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.ItemBg}):Play()
		end
	end)

	if FirstTab then
		FirstTab = false
		page.Visible = true
		tabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent
		tabIcon.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
		tabText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
	end

	return page
end

local function AddLabel(parent, text)
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = Theme.Accent
	label.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	label.TextSize = 12
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.Parent = parent
end

local function AddButton(parent, text, callback)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.ItemBg
	btn.Text = "  " .. text
	btn.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	btn.TextSize = 12
	btn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	btn.AutoButtonColor = false
	btn.Parent = parent

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = btn

	btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.ItemHover}):Play()
	end)

	btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.ItemBg}):Play()
	end)

	btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		local pulse = TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)})
		pulse:Play()
		pulse.Completed:Connect(function()
			TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.ItemHover, TextColor3 = Theme.Text}):Play()
		end)
		pcall(callback)
	end)
end

local function AddToggle(parent, text, defaultState, callback)
	local enabled = defaultState or false

	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.ItemBg
	frame.Parent = parent

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = frame

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 1, 0)
	title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = text
	title.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
	title.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	title.TextSize = 12
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Parent = frame

	local pill = Instance.new("Frame")
	pill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 20)
	pill.Position = UDim2.new(1, -50, 0.5, -10)
	pill.BackgroundColor3 = enabled and Theme.Accent or Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
	pill.Parent = frame

	local pCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	pCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	pCorner.Parent = pill

	local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
	knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
	knob.Position = enabled and UDim2.new(1, -18, 0.5, -8) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -8)
	knob.BackgroundColor3 = enabled and Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15) or Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	knob.Parent = pill

	local kCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	kCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	kCorner.Parent = knob

	local clickArea = Instance.new("TextButton")
	clickArea.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	clickArea.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	clickArea.Text = ""
	clickArea.Parent = frame

	clickArea.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		enabled = not enabled
		if enabled then
			TweenService:Create(pill, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent}):Play()
			TweenService:Create(knob, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				Position = UDim2.new(1, -18, 0.5, -8),
				BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
			}):Play()
		else
			TweenService:Create(pill, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)}):Play()
			TweenService:Create(knob, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -8),
				BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
			}):Play()
		end
		pcall(function() callback(enabled) end)
	end)
end

local function AddSlider(parent, text, min, max, default, callback)
	local value = default or min

	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.ItemBg
	frame.Parent = parent

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = frame

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0, 22)
	title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 4)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = text
	title.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
	title.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	title.TextSize = 12
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Parent = frame

	local valLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	valLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 22)
	valLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -62, 0, 4)
	valLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	valLabel.Text = tostring(value)
	valLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Accent
	valLabel.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	valLabel.TextSize = 12
	valLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	valLabel.Parent = frame

	local barBg = Instance.new("Frame")
	barBg.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 6)
	barBg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 32)
	barBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 24)
	barBg.Parent = frame

	local bCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	bCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	bCorner.Parent = barBg

	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.Size = UDim2.new((value - min) / (max - min), 0, 1, 0)
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent
	fill.Parent = barBg

	local fCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	fCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	fCorner.Parent = fill

	local isDragging = false
	local function UpdateSlider(input)
		local pos = math.clamp((input.Position.X - barBg.AbsolutePosition.X) / barBg.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
		value = math.floor(min + ((max - min) * pos))
		valLabel.Text = tostring(value)
		
		TweenService:Create(fill, TweenInfo.new(0.05, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Size = UDim2.new(pos, 0, 1, 0)
		}):Play()
		
		pcall(function() callback(value) end)
	end

	barBg.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			isDragging = true
			UpdateSlider(input)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			isDragging = false
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if isDragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			UpdateSlider(input)
		end
	end)
end

local function AddTextBox(parent, text, placeholder, callback)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.ItemBg
	frame.Parent = parent

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = frame

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
	title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = text
	title.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
	title.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	title.TextSize = 12
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Parent = frame

	local input = Instance.new("TextBox")
	input.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 24)
	input.Position = UDim2.new(1, -130, 0.5, -12)
	input.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 24)
	input.PlaceholderText = placeholder or "Type..."
	input.Text = ""
	input.TextColor3 = Theme.Accent
	input.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	input.TextSize = 11
	input.Parent = frame

	local iCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	iCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

	input.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
		if enterPressed then
			pcall(function() callback(input.Text) end)
		end
	end)
end

local function AddDropdown(parent, text, options, callback)
	local isOpen = false

	local container = Instance.new("Frame")
	container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38)
	container.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.ItemBg
	container.ClipsDescendants = true
	container.Parent = parent

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = container

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 38)

scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- 1. Create the ScreenGui Container
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "FaceChangerGui"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

-- 2. Create the Main Frame
local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 200)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0.4, -100) -- Centered on screen
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) -- Black
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 3
mainFrame.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0) -- White border for contrast
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

-- 3. Create the Title TextLabel
local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
titleLabel.Name = "TitleLabel"
titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
titleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
titleLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
titleLabel.BorderSizePixel = 3
titleLabel.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
titleLabel.Text = "Work at a Pizza Place FE Face Changer"
titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
titleLabel.TextSize = 12
titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Legacy
titleLabel.Parent = mainFrame

-- 4. Create the ID TextBox
local idTextBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
idTextBox.Name = "IDTextBox"
idTextBox.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 40)
idTextBox.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.3, 10)
idTextBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
idTextBox.BorderSizePixel = 3
idTextBox.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
idTextBox.PlaceholderText = "Enter Decal ID Here..."
idTextBox.Text = ""
idTextBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
idTextBox.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
idTextBox.TextSize = 14
idTextBox.Font = Enum.Font.Legacy
idTextBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
idTextBox.Parent = mainFrame

-- 5. Create the Submit TextButton
local submitButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
submitButton.Name = "SubmitButton"
submitButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 40)
submitButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.6, 20)
submitButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) submitButton.BorderSizePixel = 3
submitButton.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
submitButton.Text = "Submit"
submitButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
submitButton.TextSize = 14
submitButton.Font = Enum.Font.Legacy
submitButton.Parent = mainFrame

-- ==========================================
-- SCRIPT LOGIC: DRAGGABLE FRAME SYSTEM
-- ==========================================
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos

local function update(input)
	local delta = input.Position - dragStart
	mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
end

mainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = mainFrame.Position
		
		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
			end
		end)
	end
end)

mainFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragInput = input
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input == dragInput and dragging then
		update(input)
	end
end)

-- ==========================================
-- SCRIPT LOGIC: SUBMIT & FIRE REMOTE EVENT
-- ==========================================
submitButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local inputId = idTextBox.Text
	
	-- Basic validation to ensure the user typed something
	if inputId == "" or not tonumber(inputId) then
		submitButton.Text = "Invalid ID!"
		task.wait(1)
		submitButton.Text = "Submit Face"
		return
	end
	
	-- Safely fetch character components
	local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local head = character:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
	
	if head then
		local face = head:WaitForChild("face", 5)
		if face then
			-- Format the arguments using the input text box ID
			local args = {
				face,
				"rbxasset://textures/face.png" -- Fallback or custom structure if needed, but dynamically using asset format:
			}
			
			-- Standard format for custom Decal IDs: "rbxassetid://" .. inputId
			args[2] = "rbxassetid://" .. inputId
			
			-- Target RemoteEvent tracking
			local mainFolder = Workspace:WaitForChild("Main", 5)
			if mainFolder then
				local changeFaceEvent = mainFolder:WaitForChild("ChangeFace", 5)
				if changeFaceEvent and changeFaceEvent:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
					-- Fire the server with arguments
					changeFaceEvent:FireServer(unpack(args))
					
					-- Visual success feedback
					submitButton.Text = "Fired Successfully!"
					task.wait(1)
					submitButton.Text = "Submit Face"
				else
					warn("ChangeFace RemoteEvent not found in workspace.Main")
				end
			else
				warn("Main folder not found in Workspace")
			end
		else
			warn("Face object not found inside Head")
		end
	else
		warn("Character Head not found")
	end
end)

scripts.script:
-- For more scripts, join discord. (https://discord.gg/JH8Kqtqq3m)

-- > Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game.GetService(game, 'ReplicatedStorage')
local UserInputService = game.GetService(game, 'UserInputService')
local Players = game.GetService(game, 'Players')

-- > Variables
local MiscHandler, LocalPlayer, Camera = require(ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild('MiscHandler', true)), Players.LocalPlayer, workspace.CurrentCamera

-- > Functions
function GetClosestTarget()
	local Target, Closest = nil, math.huge
	for Index, Value in next, Players.GetPlayers(Players) do
		if LocalPlayer == Value or (Value.Team and Value.Team.Name == 'Lobby') or (LocalPlayer.Team and LocalPlayer.Team.Name ~= 'FFA' and (LocalPlayer.Team == Value.Team or ((MiscHandler.Relationships[LocalPlayer.Team.Name] and MiscHandler.Relationships[LocalPlayer.Team.Name][Value.Team and Value.Team.Name]) or 'Enemy') == 'Friendly')) then continue end
		--
		local Character = Value.Character
		if not Character then continue end
		--
		local Head = game.FindFirstChild(Character, 'Head')
		if not Head then continue end
		--
		local Humanoid = game.FindFirstChildOfClass(Character, 'Humanoid')
		if not Humanoid or Humanoid.Health <= 0 then continue end
		--
		local Obscuring = Camera.GetPartsObscuringTarget(Camera, {Camera.CFrame.Position, Head.Position}, {Character, LocalPlayer.Character})
		for Meow = #Obscuring, 1, -1 do
			local Part = Obscuring[Meow]
			if Part.Transparency >= 1 or not Part.CanCollide then
				table.remove(Obscuring, Meow)
			end
		end
		--
		if #Obscuring > 0 then continue end
		--
		local Vector, OnScreen = Camera.WorldToViewportPoint(Camera, Head.Position)
		if not OnScreen then continue end
		--
		local Distance = (Vector2.new(Vector.X, Vector.Y) - UserInputService.GetMouseLocation(UserInputService)).Magnitude
		if Distance < Closest then Closest, Target = Distance, Head end
	end
	--
	return Target
end

-- > Connections
local Identity, Detected, Kill = getthreadidentity(), nil, nil

setthreadidentity(2)
for Index, Value in next, getgc(true) do
  if typeof(Value) == 'function' then
    if debug.getinfo(Value).name == 'recoil' then
      hookfunction(Value, function(...) end)
    end
  elseif typeof(Value) == 'table' then
    if typeof(rawget(Value, 'Detected')) == 'function' and not Detected then
      Detected = rawget(Value, 'Detected') hookfunction(Detected, function(...) return true end)
    elseif rawget(Value, 'Variables') and rawget(Value, 'Process') and typeof(rawget(Value, 'Kill')) == 'function' and not Kill then
      Kill = rawget(Value, 'Kill') hookfunction(Kill, function(...) end)
    end
  end
end

local Original; Original = hookfunction(getrenv().debug.info, newcclosure(function(...)
	local Args = {...}
	if Detected and Args[1] == Detected then
		return coroutine.yield(coroutine.running())
	end
	--
	return Original(table.unpack(Args))
end))

setthreadidentity(Identity)

	local Args, Method, Script = {...}, getnamecallmethod(), getcallingscript()
	if self == workspace and Method == 'Raycast' and tostring(Script) == 'WeaponSystem_Overhaul' then
		local Target = GetClosestTarget()
		if not Target then return Original(self, table.unpack(Args)) end
		Args[2] = (Target.Position - Args[1]).Unit * 1000
	end
	--
	return Original(self, table.unpack(Args))
end))

scripts.features:
Ronix Hub - Command An Army

Farm
- Auto farm, moves you onto the next enemy troop and keeps swinging
- Pick how you get there: teleport above, walk up, or drop in behind
- Height offset (2-20) and distance offset (2-15)
- Attack delay (0.01-0.5 s) and hits per cycle (1-10)
- Target priority: closest, lowest HP or frontline first
- Go after enemy troops, enemy workers, or both
- Turns you to face whatever you are hitting
- Live counters for farm status, enemies alive, allies and total hits

Kill Aura
- Hits the best enemy in range without teleporting you
- Range slider (10-100 studs)
- Its own target pick: lowest HP, closest or frontline first

Summon
- Auto summon, Summon 10 or Summon 1
- Skips the summon animation
- Stops by itself when you pull a 4-star, switch that off to keep going
- Gem reserve (0-5000), it never spends below the number you set
- Summon 10 and Summon 1 buttons
- Teleport to the summon area, open the summon menu, refresh the banner
- Shows your gems, 3-star pity out of 50, 4-star pity out of 400, luck and summon count

Teams and Map Vote
- Auto pick Attackers, Defenders, or whichever side has fewer players
- Join either side with one button, or open the team picker
- Cancel your lobby queue
- Live team count
- Auto vote for the map choice you set (1-4)
- Vote buttons that put you on the pad for each choice

Ranked
- Start or cancel the ranked queue
- Region: Auto, US East, US West, EU Central or Asia East
- Rejoin your ranked match, by hand or automatically
- Create or leave a party
- Shows your rank, RR and queue status

Rounds
- Auto join a round already in progress, or answer that prompt yourself
- Answers the Potato Mode prompt with the choice you set
- Close the match result screen
- Current state and round timer

Defense
- Auto block when an enemy within range (5-50 studs) swings at you
- Block and release buttons
- Anti stun, clears stuns and knockdowns as they land, on by default

Stamina and Movement
- Infinite stamina
- Infinite dodge roll, no cooldown and no stamina cost, Q on PC
- Auto roll while you move
- Roll speed multiplier (1-3)
- Single roll and a 5 roll burst
- Custom WalkSpeed (16-100) and RunSpeed (26-150)
- Auto sprint and sprint speed lock
- Mount or dismount your horse from the menu

ESP
- Name tags on enemy troops, your own troops and workers, each in its own colour
- Clear and reload button

Misc
- Anti AFK, on by default
- Server hop and rejoin
- Mute troop footsteps or all troop sounds
- Ping and FPS readout

Mobile friendly. Join discord.gg/ronixstudios for support and updates.
